decisions.reason: The formwork profile system builds directly on the firm's core formwork knowledge and has several models, so the firm can read customer feedback and refine it with its own R&D.
Automated concrete distributor flow control fits the firm's strategic push into automation and draws on its engineering and software expertise, so in-house R&D can absorb lessons and improve it.
The shuttering magnet line extends the firm's established magnetic formwork competence, making it easy to assimilate and adjust within the system offer.
Magnetic formwork strips are a core-adjacent product line, and the firm's existing knowledge lets it interpret their results and keep developing them.
This magnetic formwork component is closely tied to the firm's knowledge base and fits its integrated formwork portfolio.
